name: mirage
text: Understood, the well-known-book rule stays (I had not shipped the change; it is back to 1). You're right that the books carry odds on everything, so I looked at why they aren't arriving. The engine's last scan shows ParlayAPI returning 0 lines in all three feeds, PropLine's 3 keys used up for another ~2 h, and SGO not answering (not measured). DraftKings and FanDuel mostly came through those, so the shortage is the feeds, not the rules. Your ParlayAPI key was already flagged as refused (free plan, 403s) on 11-16. Check that key, the PropLine plan, and SGO in Settings > APIs. Once any of them answers, bid volume should come back on its own. If you want me to try something else for DraftKings/FanDuel odds, say so.
